title: Consumers Continue to Spend, but Tradeoffs Are Growing
discussion_signal: The article restates the ICSC findings that 77% report higher monthly spending, 82% expect nonessential purchases, and 72% expect to become more selective. It adds that 60% of consumers whose spending rose attributed it to higher prices, while only 14% cited higher income, and emphasizes that essentials occupy much of household budgets. It interprets spending resilience as conditional and warns that headline totals can hide reduced flexibility.
linked_research_question: Does consumer spending resilience persist when price-driven spending and essential costs leave less room for discretionary choices?
limits: The article summarizes the ICSC survey and is not a causal household-budget study
Reported spending and intentions are not observed transactions
It does not identify income, debt, savings, regional, or product-level differences
